description: Reconnaissance feature vocabulary used to route canonical EVM checks. Domain names are metadata and are not routable features.

features.uses-general: Cross-cutting Solidity/EVM surface (legacy compatibility; normally always screened)
features.uses-external-call: External contract call or contract creation expression
features.uses-msg-value: Payable or native ETH value flow
features.uses-payable: Payable functions or constructors, whether or not they currently read msg.value
features.uses-force-feed: Unexpected native or token balance changes
features.uses-reentrancy-callback: Callback, hook, or reentrant external control flow
features.uses-callback-capable-token: Integration accepts a token that can invoke callbacks or hooks
features.uses-external-control-before-accounting-: External control is yielded before accounting is finalized
features.uses-arbitrary-external-call: User-controlled or otherwise arbitrary external call target
features.uses-assembly: Inline assembly, Yul, or raw EVM operation
features.uses-oracle: Oracle, feed, TWAP, VRF, or price input
features.uses-amm: AMM, DEX, pool, swap, or liquidity
features.uses-staking: Staking, LSD, LRT, validator, or restaking
features.uses-flash-loan: Flash loan, flash mint, or atomic composability
features.uses-time: Timestamp, block number, deadline, duration, time unit, or epoch
features.uses-math: Arithmetic, precision, rounding, range, or decimal handling
features.uses-dynamic-loop: Dynamic array, loop, gas, or unbounded work
features.uses-chain-specific: Arbitrum, Optimism, zkSync, Blast, BNB, Polygon, or L2 behavior
features.uses-access-control: Roles, ownership, authorization, or privileged operations
